units.source_text: “有什么可拖拖拉拉、缩手缩脚的事？

en.t: What is there to drag your feet over, to shrink back from?

units.source_text: ……够了吧，其实，问题不仅仅是我一个人，

en.t: ...That is enough, isn't it? Actually, this is not only my problem,

units.source_text: 你不也是跟我一样的受害者吗？

en.t: aren't you a victim just like me?

units.source_text: 难道不是吗？

en.t: Isn't that so?

units.source_text: 刚才你说，这里的事给外面知道会惹麻烦的……

en.t: Just now you said it would cause trouble if people outside found out about this place...

units.source_text: 这不就证明你自己也承认这日子不合理吗？

en.t: Doesn't that prove that you yourself admit this way of life is unreasonable?

units.source_text: 过着这种奴隶般的生活，你还是放下那代言人的臭架子吧！

en.t: Living this slave-like life, you should drop that rotten pose of being their spokesperson!

units.source_text: ……谁也没有权力把你关在这里！

en.t: ...No one has the right to keep you locked up here!

units.source_text: ……快，快去把人叫来！

en.t: ...Quick, hurry and go call someone here!

units.source_text: ……从这儿出去！

en.t: ...Get out of here!

units.source_text: ……哈哈，懂了吧……

en.t: ...Ha ha, now you understand, don't you...

units.source_text: 你害怕了吧？

en.t: You are scared, aren't you?

units.source_text: ……傻乎乎的！

en.t: ...How stupid!

units.source_text: ……有什么值得害怕的！

en.t: ...What is there worth being afraid of!

units.source_text: ……我跟着你……

en.t: ...I will go with you...

units.source_text: 我还有在报社里工作的朋友……

en.t: I also have friends who work at a newspaper...

units.source_text: 我们把这事作为社会问题来抓嘛……

en.t: We can take this up as a social issue...

units.source_text: 怎么样，干吧……

en.t: What do you say? Let's do it...

units.source_text: 怎么还不开口？

en.t: Why still won't you say anything?

units.source_text: 我说过，没什么可发抖的事嘛！”

en.t: I told you, there is nothing to tremble about!"
